neighbours.label: the subject (and its verb) of a clause giving an opposing side's view after a contrast marker in news reporting (But critics..., For its part, X...)

Ministers welcomed the trade deal. For their part, farmers fear cheap imports will undercut them.

El gobierno celebró el acuerdo. Por su parte, los ecologistas advierten de graves daños.
The developers promise hundreds of jobs. Conservationists, though, warn the wetland will be lost.
